name: comp-59
blurb: Simple textarea field for longer text input.
description: A basic textarea component with a label. Minimal styling using the shadcn textarea primitive.
use_when: Any form field that needs multi-line text entry (comments, descriptions, feedback).
avoid_when: You need character limits, rich text editing, or auto-resize behavior.
a11y: Label linked to textarea via htmlFor. No additional a11y features.
